run_gmock_doctor: pipe compiler error output into gmock_doctor.py via stdin to get plain-English diagnoses of Google Mock usage mistakes
diagnose_gmock_errors: call Diagnose with a compiler error message string to get a list of human-readable Google Mock problem diagnoses
review_generic_diagnoser: review the _GenericDiagnoser factory function that yields diagnoses by pattern-matching regexes against compiler error output
review_common_gmock_symbols: review the _COMMON_GMOCK_SYMBOLS list of matchers, actions, and cardinalities used to detect missing namespace imports
summarize_diagnosers: summarize the 13 diagnoser functions that detect common Google Mock mistakes like wrong return types, overloaded functions, and pointer misuse
